journey.name: wear receive qr
journey.description:
The Receive page opens a full-screen QR of an amountless invoice; ambient mode hides the QR and waking the watch shows it again. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack and › Restored wallet, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped, and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures). Gestures are written for the 454 px screen; scale them as in README › What differs. The QR content is not in `android layout`: README › Reading the receive invoice takes it from the log.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left once: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Verify the Receive page: "WatchReceiveOpen" is listed
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr" (README, top)
Verify from a screenshot that a black-on-white QR code fills the middle of the screen
Read the invoice from the log as in README › Reading the receive invoice and verify it starts with "lnbcrt"
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchReceiveHidden" is listed with the content-desc "QR hidden"
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchReceiveHidden" is not listed
Verify from a screenshot that the QR code shows again
